mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT is in monotone four-week deterioration (-42.6 to -52.6), and transit stations are the co-movement leader for discretionary shopping trips; as long as transit stays on this downward path, RETAIL_REC will print lower over the next four weeks than its last-28-day mean.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT declined in each of the last four weekly means, from -42.6 to -52.6
failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is at or above its last-28-day mean (-38.675) while TRANSIT weekly means continue to fall or stay below -48.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL crossed above the +5.0 baseline band (5.0, 4.7, 5.3, 6.6) and is still climbing, marking a home-confinement regime in which discretionary out-of-home spending is substituted away; the crossing itself, not the level, is what forces the retail decline.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL weekly mean crosses above +5.0 (observed 5.3 at t-1w and 6.6 at t-0w)
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL rose from 4.7 at t-2w to 6.6 at t-0w, the only positive series in the snapshot
failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days rises above its last-28-day mean in the four weeks after RESIDENTIAL first closes above +5.0.

mechanism_narrative: The joint fall of GROCERY_PHARM (-20.3 to -30.4) and TRANSIT (-42.6 to -52.6) identifies a shift from trip-chaining to single-purpose essential errands; without chained errands, incidental retail-and-recreation footfall disappears, so RETAIL_REC declines more than either input alone predicts.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM fell 10.1 points and TRANSIT fell 10.0 points over the last four weekly means
failure_condition: When both GROCERY_PHARM and TRANSIT are falling jointly, next-28-day mean RETAIL_REC is not lower than last-28-day mean RETAIL_REC.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS visits collapsed from -4.7 to -22.0 in four weeks, the sharpest relative move in the snapshot, ending the mid-August outdoor-leisure season; because park trips and weekend retail trips share the same household time budget, the lost outdoor-leisure block is not reallocated to shopping and RETAIL_REC falls within one week.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS fell 17.3 points over four weekly means, from -4.7 to -22.0
regime_hint: late-summer season end under tightening restrictions
failure_condition: In the week after PARKS falls more than 5 points week-on-week, RETAIL_REC rises rather than falls.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES fell more than 3 points in two consecutive weeks (-27.0 to -28.0 to -33.9 to -38.0), the signature of a mandated remote-work directive; employer mandates lead retail-and-recreation closures by roughly a month, so the retail trough is still ahead and RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks will be lower.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES weekly mean drops more than 3 points week-on-week in two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES declined 11.0 points across four weekly means with accelerating weekly drops at t-1w and t-0w
failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days meets or exceeds its last-28-day mean despite WORKPLACES having fallen more than 3 points in two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: Every one of the six series moved in the containment direction simultaneously in the last four weeks, a breadth-of-movement signature that only occurs when restrictions are tightened in a coordinated package; coordinated packages have forward-loaded retail closures, so RETAIL_REC keeps falling over the following four weeks rather than stabilising.
candidate_trigger: At least five of six series deteriorate in the same week-on-week direction for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:five series fell and RESIDENTIAL rose in each of the last four weekly means
failure_condition: Next-28-day mean RETAIL_REC is higher than last-28-day mean RETAIL_REC following a week in which all six series moved in the containment direction together.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of rising RESIDENTIAL (+6.6) and falling GROCERY_PHARM (-30.4) means households are staying home and cutting even essential trips, a stockpiling-then-withdrawal pattern; because essential trips are the last to survive, their contraction signals that discretionary retail trips will contract proportionally further over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL is positive while GROCERY_PHARM falls more than 4 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM fell 5.5 points week-on-week at t-0w while RESIDENTIAL rose to 6.6
failure_condition: When GROCERY_PHARM falls more than 4 points week-on-week with RESIDENTIAL positive, next-28-day mean RETAIL_REC is not lower than last-28-day mean RETAIL_REC.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT has crossed below -50 (-52.6 at t-0w), a level at which the remaining trips are largely non-discretionary and the mobility series hit a behavioural floor; once transit stops making new lows, the marginal retail closure stops and RETAIL_REC mean-reverts upward over the following four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean falls below -50.0 (crossed at t-0w, -52.6)
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT weekly change decelerated from -4.0 points at t-1w to -3.9 points at t-0w while still below -50
